description: This header file defines interfaces and constants for xdiff functionalities, including diff computation, line comparison, and configuration handling within the xdiff library.

methods.name: xdiff_emit_line_fn
methods.description: Function pointer type for emitting lines during diffing, can signal early termination.

methods.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
methods.description: Function pointer type for emitting diff hunks.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Computes the diff between two memory-mapped files.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Outputs the diff between two files with custom formatting functions.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads a blob object into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets the search function for diffing.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears the search function for diffing.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a conflict style name into an internal code.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two strings of specified lengths with whitespace consideration flags.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Generates a hash for a string considering whitespace flags.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
